description: apply_header_form returns Value::Null for AsAddresses, AsGroupedAddresses, AsDate, AsMessageIds, AsURLs without any comment or error. Clients already relying on null results will silently break when real parsing is added in a future PR. The public API surface for header: property results is effectively locked to null for five of seven forms.
title: apply_header_form stubs return null, locking in silent null behavior
